welcome: Welcome to your pension account, %s. You don land!
balance: The money wey dey your RSA na ₦%s.
contribution_received: We don receive your contribution of ₦%s for %s.
benefit_approved: Your benefit request of ₦%s don approve.
benefit_rejected: Dem no approve your benefit request. Reason: %s.
i_am_alive_reminder: Oga/Madam %s, abeg confirm say you dey alive so your pension go continue to drop.
i_am_alive_confirmed: Thank you. We don record say you dey alive.
transfer_complete: Your RSA transfer go %s don complete.
statement_ready: Your statement for %s don ready. You fit download am now.
penalty_applied: Penalty of ₦%s dey on top the late remittance for %s.
fee_charged: Dem don charge administration fee of ₦%s from your RSA.
pin_issued: Your RSA PIN na %s. Guard am well.
account_suspended: Dem don suspend your account. Abeg contact support.
payment_received: We don receive payment of ₦%s. Thank you.
error_generic: Something no work. Abeg try again.
chat.balance: Your RSA balance dey your latest statement. Dial *789# press 1 to hear am.
chat.last_contribution: Your last contribution dey your statement. Dial *789# press 2.
chat.statement: Your statement don ready for the app or email. Dial *789# press 3.
chat.i_am_alive: To confirm say you dey alive, open the app do liveness check, or dial *789# press 4.
chat.transfer_status: RSA transfer dey complete within 365 days of your request. Dial *789# press 5 for status.
chat.unknown: Sorry, I no understand. Try: balance, contribution, statement, alive, transfer, projection, grow, fund, mortgage, claim, nominee, or learn.
chat.projection: See your retirement projection for the app (Grow tab) or dial *789# press 6.
chat.grow: You fit increase your savings with auto-escalation or round-up for the app (Grow tab), or dial *789# press 7.
chat.fund_choice: Change your fund (I-IV) for the app under Funds, or dial *789# press 8.
chat.mortgage: You fit use up to 25% of your RSA for mortgage equity. Apply for the app (Home tab) or dial *789# press 9.
chat.claims: Start your retirement claim for the app (Claims tab) — fast-track dey finish in days. Or dial *789# press 10.
chat.nominee: Update your next-of-kin for the app (Family tab) or dial *789# press 11.
chat.learn: Learn about pension for your language for the app (Learn tab) or dial *789# press 12.
